agent_explanation: A 1s emergency on N at t=31 preempts EW green, forcing EW into yellow at step 31 (seen EW yellow at step 31, all-red at 37). That preemption corrupts or fails to reset the shared yellow timer, so the next NS yellow (steps 104-107) is cut short to 4s instead of yellow_seconds=6, turning red at step 108. Removing only the emergency event removes the violation.
